title: The expanded Revenue chart follows the Revenue tile's date range
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • {Location-A} has invoices on several days this month, in last quarter and across the last twelve months.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar (the Revenue tile opens on This Month).
  2. Click View details on Revenue.
  3. Read the labels along the bottom of the Revenue chart and count the bars.
  4. Set the Revenue pill to Last Quarter.
  5. Read the chart's labels and count the bars.
  6. Set the Revenue pill to Last 12 Months.
  7. Read the chart's labels and count the bars.
  8. Hover each of the twelve bars, write down its amount and add them up.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The chart is day by day: its labels are days of this month, not months.
  • Step 5: The chart is week by week across the three months of last quarter (about 13 bars).
  • Step 7: Twelve bars, one per month, from the month eleven months back to this month (for example Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 when tested in October 2026).
  • Step 8: The twelve amounts add up to the Revenue headline for Last 12 Months.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9578 (Story 6, Expanding a Tile); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S6-R3a (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 5 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14), S4-R11, S10-R8 and the Revenue row of the S3-R2 table (since version 42); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R3a: “The expanded Revenue chart covers the tile's own date range (S7-R5), with one bar per day, week, month or quarter chosen from the length of the range by the same rule as the sparkline (S4-R11). Last 12 Months shows twelve monthly bars; This Month shows daily bars.”
  • S4-R11: “The sparkline draws one point per bucket, and the bucket size is chosen from the length of the selected range: a range of 31 days or fewer buckets by day; 32 to 182 days by week; 183 to 731 days by month; anything longer by quarter. Each point is the measure recomputed over that bucket using the same calculation as the headline, so a point can never disagree with the tile it sits in. A bucket for which the measure has no value (S3-E3) contributes no point, and interior gaps are preserved rather than closed up or drawn as zero. When fewer than two points have values, no line is drawn and the tile shows the empty-chart placeholder instead (S4-R12).”
  • S10-R8: “"Last 12 months" covers the same window on every tile and in every report the dashboard links to: from the first day of the month eleven months before the current month, through today, in the workplace's timezone. Example: on October 5, 2026 it covers November 1, 2025 to October 5, 2026.”
  • S3-R2 (Revenue row of the measure table): “Sum of invoice subtotals in the selected range, before any discount and before tax, minus credit memos. Shown to the cent.”
